overlap.title: Intercession precedes relenting, but further punishment remains
overlap.summary: The threat of destroying the people is withdrawn; the chapter still narrates killings and plague.
overlap.reasoning: Relenting from the announced destruction should not be equated with cancellation of every consequence. The account contains both intercession and severe punishment. In Numbers 14, pardon therefore does not mean removal of every consequence.
overlap.scope: This reports the narrative’s sequence, not an independent casualty count, diagnosis of the plague or justification of the violence. Theological conclusions about divine change require a wider comparison.
